    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Each action is a button with its own name; the thumbs and Read aloud are toggle buttons with aria-pressed, thumbs down has aria-expanded for the feedback row
      - listitem: Tooltips repeat the button names, so they are hidden from screen readers; they also show on keyboard focus
      - listitem: Copied, the version you switched to, Reading aloud and Thanks are announced through a polite live region
      - listitem: The version arrows are disabled at either end, and the count is read as "Version 2 of 3"
      - listitem: While closed, the feedback row is inert – nothing hidden can be focused
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Copy blurs into a green check; it turns back after a moment
      - listitem: Regenerate spins once per press, and keeps spinning while regenerating is true
      - listitem: A vote gives the thumb a small pop and the selected-tab look; the feedback row unfolds below the bar and folds away after Thanks
      - listitem: The version switcher unfolds sideways from Regenerate; its number crossfades, and MessageText crossfades the message while its height eases
      - listitem: Read aloud swaps the speaker for four bouncing blue bars
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches without movement and the bars stand still
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The bar is about 220px wide with the switcher; the feedback row has no card of its own – it fills its container (ideally the last row of your message card) and its reasons wrap
      - listitem: Below 320px the Send button takes its own line under the reasons
      - listitem: "Touch screens: 36px buttons, taller reasons, no hover tooltips (only \"Copied\"), and the bar is never faded"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Put data-ui-message on the element that wraps the message and the bar – that is what lights the quiet bar up on hover
      - listitem: Keep versions per message in your state and pass version + onVersionChange; after a regenerate, set version to the new last index
      - listitem: onFeedback fires twice for a thumbs down with a reason – once with only the vote, once with the reason. Upsert by message and version instead of inserting rows
      - listitem: The bar does not speak by itself – pass speaking and onSpeak and drive speechSynthesis or your TTS from there
